verdict.rationale: Runway's own API guide tells developers to install the official Runway SDK via npm, and the developer platform publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. A probe returned HTTP 200 for that spec. Together these give developers a first-party SDK path for building against the API. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond the npm/JavaScript one (e.g. Python), SDK reference documentation depth, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
